**Campanile 0.1.1: the Raspberry Pi path, ready for its first real board.**

The Raspberry Pi guide was followed step by step on the real Raspberry Pi OS, as someone new to
the project would, several times over. Everything that got in the way is fixed.

**What's new**

- **One block to paste on a Raspberry Pi.** Write your area's four numbers (read on
  openstreetmap.org) and your country's two letters, then paste. It runs whole in any terminal,
  and pasted again it updates without downloading anything twice.
- **Safer changes of mind.** `--no-hotspot` now takes down the open Wi-Fi too, not only its
  firewall. The Wi-Fi country is never guessed. Uninstalling leaves nginx as it was before.
- **Water and toilets without a name are found**, as most are. A category button shows only
  that kind of place, never a village with the same name. Living streets are searchable, and
  "kings parade" finds King's Parade.
- **Directions** from any place found, straight to the navigator.
- **IT | EN at the top of every page.** Closing a post or a name takes a second tap, and the
  page says it is done.
- **American neighborhoods:** miles and feet on an American phone, 911 once set on the admin
  page, and addresses written short ("Vashon Hwy SW").
- **A simpler home page:** official notices first, then "I need" and "I can give".
- **Security, from our own reviews:** weak signing keys refused, closed posts wiped from the
  file, name searches that can't slow the board, notices signed in the future refused, and
  more. Each fix comes with a test that fails on the old code.

**Check this package yourself**, with a copy you already trust, such as a clone of this
repository (not the package's own checker, which could lie about itself): `python3
campanile/release.py path/to/campanile-0.1.1` says whether every program file is the one
CarrotStudio signed. `SHA256SUMS` and the build provenance (`gh attestation verify
campanile-0.1.1.zip -R Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile`) are here too.

**Download:** `campanile-0.1.1.zip` below. Unzip it, then double-click *Avvia Campanile
(Windows)* or *Avvia Campanile (Mac)*. For a Raspberry Pi:
[docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#raspberry-pi).
A Campanile 0.1.0 updates from a USB stick holding this version.

**Still experimental.** Tested on macOS, Windows and Linux, and on the real Raspberry Pi OS in
containers. **Not yet tried for real:** a Raspberry Pi's own Wi-Fi with real phones, Android
phones as guests, many phones at once, non-technical families. If you have a Pi and two phones,
please tell us how it went. Our limits, honestly:
[docs/LIMITS.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/LIMITS.md).

---

**Campanile 0.1.1: la strada del Raspberry Pi, pronta per la prima scheda vera.** La guida è stata
seguita passo per passo sulla vera Raspberry Pi OS, e ogni ostacolo è stato tolto: un solo blocco
da incollare, la mappa della tua zona per prima, il paese del Wi-Fi mai indovinato. In più: acqua
e bagni trovati anche senza nome, «Come arrivarci» da ogni luogo trovato, la pillola IT | EN in
alto e altre correzioni di sicurezza. Scarica `campanile-0.1.1.zip`, scompatta e fai doppio clic
su *Avvia Campanile (Windows)* o *(Mac)*. È ancora una versione sperimentale: i nostri limiti
sono in [docs/LIMITI.md](https://github.com/Carrotstudiosoftwarehouse/campanile/blob/main/docs/LIMITI.md).
